milestones.label: Institutions' proposal window (universities and research institutes apply to CNPq to host PEC-PG students; not a student deadline)
milestones.source_text: The CNPq page for call 16/2026 (official) shows the institutional registration window as 29 June to 13 August 2026. This is the step where Brazilian universities and institutes ask for scholarship quotas.

milestones.label: CNPq publishes the decision on which institutions take part (and so which programmes can take PEC-PG students)
milestones.source_text: The Brazilian foreign ministry's PEC-PG page (official, read through a search summary because the page itself showed a verification screen) puts the final list of selected institutions in December 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline for students: not announced; each selected institution sets its own selection schedule
milestones.source_text: Section 2.2 of CNPq call 16/2026 (official) says the schedule for choosing master's and doctoral candidates will be published later by the selected institutions and CNPq.

milestones.label: Scholarship selection and start window
milestones.source_text: The foreign ministry's PEC-PG page (official, via search summary) lists March 2027 to March 2028 as the period for choosing scholars and starting the scholarships; one scholarship guide (unofficial) reports the same.
